text: Aisha Wahab (D), recommended for CD-14 (CA) United States Representative, is a confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community. She answered "Yes" at an April 2026 forum when asked whether Israel had committed genocide in Gaza, introduced a California Senate resolution describing the conflict as genocide, and cosponsored H.R. 3565 (Block the Bombs Act). She voted No on defunding universities that boycott Israel (2026-09-03). She did not sponsor bills recognizing the Nakba, calling for humanitarian aid for Gaza, restoring UNRWA funding, or recognizing the genocide of the Palestinian people. CAIR Action endorsed her; Vote for Peace rated her Ally; BAMC Action supported her; JStreetPAC endorsed her. UDP independently spent $1,642,139.53 opposing her; BOLD America independently spent $610,970.50 opposing. J Street Action Fund independently spent $104,048.34 supporting. Melissa Hernandez (D) declined to call the Gaza conflict genocide at an April 2026 forum, supports continued U.S. security assistance to Israel, and rejects the BDS movement. Hindu American PAC endorsed Hernandez. UDP independently spent $825,292.77 and BOLD America $1,838,225.31 supporting Hernandez.
